Name: lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for East Scarp (East Scarpe)
Author: lunakatt
Description:
[size=4]lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for East Scarp (prev East Scarpe)[/size]

[size=4][size=3]This is a mod in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod[/url], for the NPCs of LemurKat's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]!

[size=4][u][b]UPDATE[/b][/u]: Rosa and Kataryna have now been added! Eloise has also been updated to fix errors :D[/size]
[u]This mod currently has a Content Patcher version and a Replacement Version only[/u], [size=2]bare with me lads :D[/size]


[u][size=4][b]Content Patcher Version:[/b][/size][/u]
[/size][/size][size=3]Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=4][size=3][size=4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/size][/size]

Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract the CP version of this mod into your mods directory
3. Run the game using SMAPI

[size=4][u][b]Replacement Version:[/b][/u][/size]
Required mods: [/size][/size]
[size=4][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url][/size][/size][/size]
[size=4][size=3][size=4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/size][/size]

[size=4][size=3]Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed[/size][/size]
2. Find where East Scarp is installed in your mods folder
3. Drag the downladed folder called "[b][CP] East Scarpe NPCs[/b]" into "[b]Stardew Valley/Mods/East Scarpe 1.7[/b]" and let it overwrite when prompted
[size=4][size=3]3. Run the game using SMAPI[/size][/size]

[b][size=4]Go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13599?tab=description]HD Portraits Patches for PyTK[/url] by purplexpresso to get a patch for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] :D
[/size][/b]Thank you to purplexpresso, go show them some love on their mod page!

[size=2][size=3]Thank you as always to DCBurger!
Thank you to LemurKat and all of the wonderful creators that contribute to East Scarp for their help and their patience :D
[/size][/size][/size][/size][size=4][size=3][size=2][size=3]Psst, go check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120691188]OrangePie[/url]'s portrait mods!

Check out my Stardew Valley Expanded portraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9029]here[/url]!
And a matchy matchy mod for the NPC Wilford [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9141]here[/url]!
And one for the NPC Denver [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9210]here[/url]!
[/size][/size][/size][/size][size=3]And the last one for Life Cycle [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9225]here[/url]!

[/size]
If you'd like, consider buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lunakatt]Ko-fi[/url]!
